description: BNB Chain token launches with a honeypot check: new four.meme tokens (curve progress, creator) and new PancakeSwap V2 pairs against WBNB/USDT/USDC/USD1/U, scanned every 2 minutes, each with a simulated ~$1 buy then a sell of all of it in the next block: round-trip loss, buy tax, sell tax, and whether a full sell reverts (retried at 10%). Verdicts hold at check time only. $0.01 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

only.description: optional: sells (only tokens that sold back) or traps (could not sell, sells only in part, or >15% round trip)

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

name: bnb_fresh_launches
